ctx.x: Benny Green. That was the band. And they blew and they blew. And I called Billy Eckstine over, I said, "Billy," I said, "just an idea. You've got a great band here." I said, "If you'll take a suggestion, I'll get you a few stocks, just simple tunes and just play maybe two of them, get them on the floor and dance. Then you play one of those -- something to please the guys, you know what I mean, to wind up the dance, see. And then we get off the floor and then we you start off with these little popular tunes.…
